payload.title: Rank 4 pointed Z2xZ2 row resolved as partial low-rank ribbon progress
payload.top_notice: The rank4-pointed-z2xz2 family row now has five hash-bound ribbon realization snapshots, one for each GL(2,2) orbit of nondegenerate quadratic forms on Z/2 x Z/2. The low-rank ribbon catalog remains partial: 8 rows resolved, 6 rows blocked, and formal scan-plan generation is still disabled.
validated_behaviors: The five rank4 pointed Z2xZ2 snapshots pass validate_formal_evidence.
The builder independently enumerates 16 nondegenerate quadratic forms on Z/2 x Z/2 and five GL(2,2) orbits, matching the row denominator without copying the rank-4 braided total.
Each snapshot records an explicit normalized abelian 3-cocycle table, R-symbol table, twist table, pivotal scalars, evaluation/coevaluation data, basis/gauge, and Q(i) field embedding.

Exact mod-4 linear solving plus exhaustive scans check pentagon, both hexagon equations, R_aa=q(a), monodromy agreement with q-bilinearization, monodromy nondegeneracy, and ribbon/pivotal compatibility.
A strict-associator-with-same-R negative control satisfies pentagon but fails both hexagon checks for each selected representative.
The v9 catalog passes validate_low_rank_ribbon_catalog as PARTIAL_RIBBON_REFINEMENT_PROGRESS.
The v9 readiness artifact keeps scan_plan_generation_allowed=false.
